operations.details: Verified official OGC KML standard page.
KML visualization geometry separated from exact parcel measurement geometry.
Display annotation not promoted to legal-boundary or terrain evidence.
KML coordinates require independent CRS/source precision validation for measurement use.
Verified official OGC GMLJP2 standard page.
JPEG2000/GML packaging separated from raw elevation measurement semantics.
Image georeferencing not promoted to bare-earth DTM vertical accuracy.
Imagery encoding/compression capability not treated as measurement confidence evidence.
KML and GMLJP2 URLs distinct from prior source registry.
No visualization or imagery-packaging value substituted for parcel height result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
